name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_OSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA indicator, opening buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a multi-layer smoothed volume-based oscillator to generate trend-momentum signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy enters on signal bar crossovers and closes opposing positions on reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA指标进行交易，当振荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓。它使用多层平滑的成交量振荡器生成趋势动量信号，并配备可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。策略在信号线交叉时入场，并在反转时平掉反向头寸。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA指标，该指标是经过7层平滑处理的基于成交量的动量振荡器，本质上是TVI（Ticks Volume Indicator）的OSMA变体。入场条件为：当Ind[1]<Ind[2]（振荡器从下降转为上升）且Ind[0]>=Ind[1]（当前值确认上升）时开多仓；当Ind[1]>Ind[2]（振荡器从上升转为下降）且Ind[0]<=Ind[1]时开空仓。出场条件为：开多信号触发时平空仓，开空信号触发时平多仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持5种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理参数MM控制风险比例（默认0.1），结合止损距离计算具体手数。策略支持新K线检测避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许回溯信号确认。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA indicator, which is a volume-based momentum oscillator processed through 7 layers of smoothing, essentially an OSMA variant of the TVI (Ticks Volume Indicator). Entry conditions: a buy is opened when Ind[1]<Ind[2] (oscillator turns from decline to rise) and Ind[0]>=Ind[1] (current value confirms upward move); a sell is opened when Ind[1]>Ind[2] (oscillator turns from rise to decline) and Ind[0]<=Ind[1]. Exit conditions: opposing positions are closed on reversal signals (sell closed on buy signal, buy closed on sell signal), with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports 5 modes via MarginMode enum: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management parameter MM controls the risk ratio (default 0.1), calculating specific lot size combined with the stop loss distance. The strategy implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trades on the same bar and uses the SignalBar parameter to allow lookback signal confirmation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：Tick成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引（0=当前bar，1=上一根完成的bar）

pros: 多层平滑处理减少了噪音干扰，信号质量相对较高
支持5种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易风格和风险偏好
同时具备止损止盈和反转平仓双重出场机制，风险控制较完善
新K线检测机制避免了同一根bar内的重复交易
买卖开关独立控制，可以灵活配置为只做多、只做空或双向交易
pros_en: Multi-layer smoothing reduces noise interference, producing relatively high-quality signals
Supports 5 money management modes, flexibly adapting to different trading styles and risk preferences
Dual exit mechanism with both stop loss/take profit and reversal-based closing provides robust risk control
New bar detection prevents repeated trades within the same bar
Independent buy/sell toggle controls allow flexible configuration for long-only, short-only, or bi-directional trading
cons: 7层平滑导致指标严重滞后，在快速行情中信号延迟明显
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时可能导致入场滑点严重
固定止损止盈没有根据市场波动率（如ATR）动态调整
SignalBar=1时存在信号确认延迟，SignalBar=0时当前bar信号可能变化
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
cons_en: 7-layer smoothing causes significant indicator lag, resulting in delayed signals during fast-moving markets
No spread filter, which may cause severe slippage on entry when spreads are wide
Fixed stop loss and take profit are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
SignalBar=1 introduces confirmation delay, while SignalBar=0 risks signal repaint on the current bar
No position check logic exists, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离
添加点差过滤和持仓方向检查，避免高点差环境下入场和重复开仓
考虑减少平滑层数或使用自适应平滑参数，降低信号滞后性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for self-adaptive adjustment of stop distances based on market volatility
Add spread filter and position direction check to avoid entry in high-spread environments and prevent duplicate position opening
Consider reducing the number of smoothing layers or using adaptive smoothing parameters to decrease signal lag

risk_points: 7层平滑导致信号滞后，可能在趋势末期才入场
没有持仓方向检查，可能重复开仓增大风险敞口
默认止损1000点/止盈2000点属于较宽范围，在剧烈行情中可能承受较大浮亏
risk_points_en: 7-layer smoothing causes signal lag, potentially entering at the tail end of trends
No position direction check may lead to duplicate openings increasing risk exposure
Default 1000-point SL / 2000-point TP is wide, potentially enduring significant drawdown during volatile markets

The strategy enters on signal bar crossovers and closes opposing positions on reversals.
